title: KMS/SSO onboarding scorecard and rollback rules for private deployments
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: This ticket formalizes the evidence scorecard, pass/fail rules, and automated rollback criteria for Private (VPC / on-prem) onboarding focused on identity and keying: SSO (SAML/OIDC), role-based access controls, audit logging, and KMS/HSM key custody. It clarifies scope changes from the initial PRD: we will defer cross-tenant key delegations and HSM operator console integrations to a follow-up cycle, and instead require synthesized operator runbooks and test vectors for KMS rotation and SSO failover. The deliverable is a sign-off checklist and gating automation (dashboard + webhook) that prevents production activation until all required evidence is validated.
acceptance_criteria: SSO metadata ingestion: Customer IdP metadata uploaded and validated against schema; test login across two user personas (admin, svc-account) succeeds in staging
RBAC matrix enforced: role bindings for Operator, Admin, Viewer mapped to IAM claims and validated by automated tests; least-privilege violations flagged
KMS key custody: CMK exists in customer KMS/HSM or customer-managed key is registered; rotation test completes with no request failures for a 30s window
Audit logging: all admin-level and crypto events emitted to configured audit endpoint for 90-day retention; sample queries return expected entries
Operational runbooks: on-call playbook, key compromise procedure, and emergency rotation steps are uploaded to Confluence and referenced in ticket links
Sign-off matrix: Security, Product, and Customer Success each provide explicit approval in ticket comments and final acceptance checklist
Automation gates: dashboard health checks (SSO probe, KMS rotation probe, RBAC regression test) report green for 24 hours before production enablement
checklist: RBAC regression suite run and passed (platform QA)
Audit export and retention confirmation (compliance lead)
Customer onboarding packet contains evidence checklist and timestamped artifacts
Rollback rule configured: automatic disable of dedicated capacity if KMS rotation fails N=3 times within 2 hours
decision_log: 2025-02-11: Decided to postpone cross-tenant key delegation (scope reduction) — rationale: risk surface and validation complexity; follow-up ticket planned
2025-02-12: Agreed to require vendor-signed HSM attestation only when customer requests hardware HSM — default is software KMS with customer-managed keys
2025-02-14: Chosen gating window of 24 hours for post-onboarding probes to balance speed and signal-to-noise for flaky IdPs

2025-02-13 Morgan Patel: Updated RBAC acceptance criteria after sync with Platform QA; added least-privilege regression tests and example audit queries in Confluence.
2025-02-15 Priya Nair (Compliance): Confirmed 90-day retention is acceptable for initial onboarding; longer-retention enterprise packs will be a separate add-on.
2025-02-17 Clara Ruiz (Solutions): Customer-facing onboarding packet draft linked; needs legal review for KMS escrow language.
2025-02-18 Security Team: All security items marked resolved pending final evidence upload and automation gate verification.
notes: This artifact must be attached to the customer's onboarding record. Automation team to implement webhook that will evaluate the scorecard and flip a feature flag when gates pass. If any gate fails post-enablement, rollback rules should trigger an immediate service disable for dedicated capacity and open pager to ops.
risks: IdP variability: some customer IdPs require per-tenant troubleshooting — plan for SRE handoff
KMS provider differences: vendor-specific rotation semantics may require provider adapters
False positives on audit retention: ensure test queries use canonical event ids to avoid flaky results
